description: This file declares classes and methods related to expanding and layout computation for Softmax and LogSoftmax operations within TensorFlow's DTensor MLIR infrastructure. It includes class declarations for SoftmaxOpSPMDExpander and SoftmaxLossOpSPMDExpander, each with methods to expand operations and compute input/output layouts.
external_methods: llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout> computeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation*, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>&)
llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout> computeLayoutBackward(mlir::Operation*, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>&)
StatusOr<Layout> maybeRelayoutInputs(mlir::Operation*, bool, const Layout&, const Layout&, const Layout&, const Layout&, Layout&, Layout&)
StatusOr<mlir::Operation*> maybeRelayoutOutputs(mlir::Operation*, const mlir::Value&, const mlir::Value&, const Layout&, const Layout&, const Layout&)

classes.name: SoftmaxOpSPMDExpander
classes.description: Handles expansion and layout computation for Softmax and LogSoftmax operations within the SPMD (Single Program Multiple Data) paradigm.

classes.name: SoftmaxLossOpSPMDExpander
classes.description: Manages expansion and layout strategies for SoftmaxCrossEntropyWithLogits operations, including relayouts of inputs and outputs.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands a softmax-related operation into its distributed form.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the input layouts required for the operation to satisfy distributed execution constraints.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the output layouts for backpropagation or gradient calculations.

methods.name: MaybeRelayoutInputs
methods.description: Calculates necessary relayouts of inputs for the softmax loss operations.

methods.name: MaybeRelayoutOutputs
methods.description: Creates relayouts for the outputs, ensuring correct data movement or identity ties.
